settings.heading: Guards with less chairtime, fewer adjustments.
settings.text: Night guards and splints your patients won’t mind wearing every night — milled to spec, added to any restorative case in one click.

settings.label: Comfort
settings.title: Durability patients love
settings.text: Our hard/soft 3D-printed guard uses thermodynamic technology for a cloud-like fit — which means higher case acceptance and nightly wear.

settings.label: One click
settings.title: Add to any restorative case
settings.text: Protect that new crown or implant by adding a guard to the same scan. We save scans, so reordering takes seconds.

settings.label: Profitability
settings.title: An easy add, no extra visits
settings.text: Bruxism and TMJ cases are rising. Offer guards without adding work or appointments — insurance on the dentistry you just delivered.

settings.title: Hard/Soft 3D-Printed Night Guard
settings.text: Strength against bruxism with thermodynamic flexibility for cloud-like comfort. Adjustable in hot water.

settings.title: Hard Night Guard
settings.text: Thermoformed, fully hard material — maximum protection for severe clenching and bruxism.

settings.title: Soft Night Guard
settings.text: Comfortable and effective against jaw pain, soreness, and headaches — best for mild cases.

settings.title: Hard/Soft Dual-Laminate
settings.text: Hard outer layer fused to a soft lining — durability with everyday comfort.

settings.title: Astron CLEARsplint
settings.text: Hard-guard strength that can be heat-adjusted for a more comfortable fit. Casted or milled.

settings.title: NTI Splint
settings.text: Small anterior device (teeth #6–9) that inhibits bruxism and relieves TMJ and temporal headaches.

settings.title: Anterior Deprogrammer
settings.text: Full-arch coverage with an anterior ramp that retrains jaw muscles and prevents bruxism.

settings.title: Dawson B-Splint & Gelb Appliance
settings.text: Specialty appliances for jaw repositioning, stress relief, and controlled vertical opening.

settings.heading: Every splint and guard we make
settings.text: From mild clenching to complex TMJ cases.

settings.question: Do guards come with a case?
settings.answer: Yes — a case and models are included with every DentSure night guard.

settings.question: Can guards be adjusted after delivery?
settings.answer: Yes — our hard/soft 3D-printed guards are adjustable after being placed in hot water.

settings.question: What do you recommend for a serious grinder with TMJ issues?
settings.answer: For the most serious bruxism cases, we recommend hard material at 4 mm thickness.
